about: A gap is not the absence of a claim but a claim at the coarsest resolution: a cell nobody has narrowed holds the whole scale, which is exactly what saying nothing says.
So a reading that is missing and a reading that says everything are the same line, and a tree with gaps is a tree read coarsely rather than a tree unread.
The cell that holds the whole scale is the lattice top, which is what a gap is.

cases.name: a cell with nothing said at it
